facts.fact: KRAY 喝到烂醉（blotto），叙述者说在场的人会替他难堪，可能还有点难过。
facts.anchor: KRAY got drunk. He got loaded. You might say he got blotto.

facts.fact: 叙述者解释他崩溃的原因：心被活生生从胸膛里扯出来，还跳着就被举到他眼前。
facts.anchor: he had just had his heart ripped — still beating, don’t you know — straight out of his chest, and then shown to him

facts.fact: 他第一下扑床完全没扑中，重重砸在床边的木地板上。
facts.anchor: Then he misses it completely. And instead he hits the wooden floor right next to it, good and hard.

facts.fact: 梦里 KRAY 变成名叫 Nick 的小男孩，最多四岁，父亲在外地打仗。
facts.anchor: KRAY is a small boy called Nick. He’s maybe four years old, tops. And his dad is off fighting a war somewhere.

facts.fact: 梦里阳台上有一位加州 Ventura 的年轻女子，大约二十一岁。
facts.anchor: right up there is this lovely young Ventura, California, woman, and she’s about twenty-one years old, give or take.

facts.fact: 一个女孩跑过走廊时在 Nick 脸颊上亲了一下，那是他永远忘不掉的初吻。
facts.anchor: she plants a kiss right on Nick’s cheek. That first kiss, the one he’ll never forget.

facts.fact: 醒来后他确定 Veronica 哭着告诉他，人事部门要把她调去 Queen Maud Land。
facts.anchor: He is sure Veronica told him Personnel was reassigning her to Queen Maud Land. She told him that through tears.

facts.fact: 章末叙述者说，看来 Nick 也许终究还是有一颗心的。
facts.anchor: So it looks like maybe Nick did have a heart after all. Maybe.
